newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares bounce back, gas firm climbs.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares bounce back, gas firm climbs.

text.p: Lithuanian shares bounced back as Lithuanian Gas climbed but volumes remained low on the sluggish bourse, dealers said.
Lithuanian Gas reversed its two-session fall, rising to 1.96 litas from 1.79 litas in comparatively high trade of 281,000 litas.

Its share price had fallen steeply in response to reports that its losses for 1996 were at least 78 million litas but its long-term prospects look good and dealers said investors jumped at a good buy.
The Baltic Shipyard also rose, gaining to 8.52 litas from 7.75 litas in trade of 33,400 litas.
Vilniaus Bank stumbled, easing to 230.00 litas from 245.00 litas in trade of 13,800 litas.
Hermis Bank also fell, slipping to 180.00 litas from 189.90 litas in trade of 12,500 litas.
Dealers said that demand was low for banking shares now as most investors interested in the sector have already taken their stakes and are prepared to sit and wait.
